title: PUTUOSEN Wall Mount Monitor Arm with Keyboard Tray, Height Adjustable Full-Motion Spring Arm Wall Mount Workstation for 17 to 32 Inch Screen up to 26.4lbs, VESA 75x75/100x100mm
features: Wide Compatibility & Heavy-Duty Capacity:This wall mount fits most 17–32 inch monitors and supports up to 26.4 lbs on the display arm and 19.8 lbs on the keyboard tray—offering reliable, heavy-duty strength for your entire setup

Full Monitor Articulation for Comfort:The monitor arm adjusts with -35° to +35° tilt, 180° swivel, and 360° rotation, making it easy to find the perfect viewing angle whether you’re sitting or standing

Large Keyboard Tray Maximizes Desk Space:The 25.7 x 9.5 inch tray provides plenty of room for both keyboard and mouse. By mounting on the wall, it frees up valuable desktop space—ideal for smaller work areas like offices, classrooms, or apartments
Sturdy Build with Clean Cable:Management:The 35 inch steel pole allows smooth height adjustment, while built-in cable clips keep cords organized and out of the way during transitions

Easy Quick-release VESA plate Installation:Simply attach the removable VESA plate (75x75mm or 100x100mm) to your monitor, then slide it onto the wall bracket. No special tools needed—just fast, hassle-free setup
